July 2026 was a bad time to be a conjecture! In my field of statistics, a conjecture related to the Bejamini-Hochberg procedure *add citation* was shown to be false and one on optimally merging e-values to p-values was proven. These results were proven with an unclear, but suspectedly high, amount of help from AI.
